entity: Share of ERCOT gas capacity able to switch to oil, before vs after the 2021 freeze (4.9% to 6.0%)
why: The FFSS procurement gives a number for the entity - 2,940 MW of dual-fuel firm-fuel capacity in ERCOT post-Uri - but under a different definition (procured service, not switch-capable capacity), and no source states the share or its rise. EIA's fuel-switching stat is national, not Texas.
